data.sub: Kam byaj daron ko lekar Donald Trump ne ki India ki tareef.

chat.say: Sir, economy padhte waqt ye news zaroor yaad rakhunga!
Dekha, global level par apna naam ho raha hai.

data.asar: Desh ki economy ki baat ho aur apna dil khush na ho, aisa ho sakta hai kya?
data.caption:
Donald Trump ne ki India ki tareef aur apne hi desh ke fed reserve par sadhe nishane! 

• Donald Trump ne ki Bharat ki tareef
• Kam byaj daron ko lekar diya bayan
